description: Turn a local file (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images and more) into a FileSeen link to paste into an email or message from any provider (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Slack, WhatsApp). Use it whenever the user is about to send or attach a document and would want to know if it was seen. Returns the link, a ready line for the email, and an id for check_if_seen.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to share.

notify.description: Email the user when it is opened. Default true.

name: create_tracked_link
